list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Gadolinium type-I organolanthanide indenyl–amido–imido cluster, THF solvate

material_class.structural_family: Type I tetranuclear indenyl–amido cluster with a central μ4-NH group

source_locations.location: Table 1, Ia; catalog formula separates one lattice THF molecule

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four Gd centers form a butterfly arrangement. Four μ2-amido ligands bridge its edges, two μ3-chlorides span metal triples, and a central μ4-NH group binds all four metals. The crystal contains one lattice THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, add a THF solution of Me2Si(C9H7)(C2B10H11) to NaNH2 suspended in THF and stir at room temperature for 20 h. Filter the purple solution into a stirred GdCl3 suspension in THF at room temperature and stir overnight.
synthesis.time: 20 h before GdCl3 addition; overnight afterward; crystallization over days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; n-hexane vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, concentrate the clear purple solution to approximately 8 mL, then diffuse n-hexane vapor to obtain colorless crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Erbium type-I organolanthanide indenyl–amido–imido cluster, THF solvate

material_class.structural_family: Type I tetranuclear indenyl–amido cluster with a central μ4-NH group

source_locations.location: Table 1, Ib; catalog formula separates one lattice THF molecule
Experimental Section, preparation of Ib referring to Ia procedure

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural with Ia: four Er centers form a butterfly arrangement linked by four μ2-amido ligands, two μ3-chlorides, and a central μ4-NH group. The crystal contains one lattice THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, follow the Ia procedure: react the ligand precursor with NaNH2 in THF for 20 h at room temperature, filter into an ErCl3 suspension in THF, and stir overnight at room temperature.
synthesis.time: 20 h before ErCl3 addition; overnight afterward; crystallization over days, following Ia procedure
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; n-hexane vapor diffusion following Ia procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Use 35 mL THF in total and follow the Ia filtration, concentration, and n-hexane vapor-diffusion procedure to obtain light-pink crystals.

material_class.structural_family: Type I tetranuclear indenyl–amido cluster with a central μ4-NH group

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, preparation of Ic referring to Ia procedure

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural with Ia and Ib: four Dy centers form a butterfly arrangement linked by four μ2-amido ligands, two μ3-chlorides, and a central μ4-NH group. Unlike Ia and Ib, the reported crystal has no lattice THF.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, follow the Ia procedure: react the ligand precursor with NaNH2 in THF at room temperature for 20 h, filter into a DyCl3 suspension in THF, and stir overnight at room temperature.
synthesis.time: 20 h before DyCl3 addition; overnight afterward; crystallization over days, following Ia procedure
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; n-hexane vapor diffusion following Ia procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Use 30 mL THF in total and follow the Ia filtration, concentration, and n-hexane vapor-diffusion procedure to obtain colorless crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Gadolinium type-II tetranuclear indenyl–amido cluster, THF solvate

source_locations.location: Table 1, IIa; catalog formula separates one lattice THF molecule
Experimental Section, preparation of IIa and alternative conversion from Ia

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four Gd centers have a distorted-tetrahedral arrangement. Two dinuclear units are joined by two μ2-chlorides and two μ3-chlorides; the dinuclear units also contain bridging NH2 groups. The crystal contains one lattice THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, add a THF solution of the ligand precursor to NaNH2 suspended in THF and stir at room temperature for 20 h. Filter the purple solution into a stirred GdCl3 suspension in THF at room temperature, then reflux overnight. Alternatively, reflux Ia (0.07 g, 0.042 mmol) with NaCl (0.10 g, 1.71 mmol) in THF (10 mL) overnight and follow the same workup.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for the initial reaction; THF reflux after GdCl3 addition
synthesis.time: 20 h initial reaction; reflux overnight; crystallization over days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; reflux and n-hexane vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, concentrate the clear purple solution to approximately 8 mL, then diffuse n-hexane vapor to obtain light-brown crystals.
synthesis.yield: 0.25 g, 54% based on GdCl3; alternative route 0.030 g, 38%

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Yttrium type-II tetranuclear indenyl–amido cluster, THF solvate

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Isostructural with IIa: four Y centers have a distorted-tetrahedral arrangement comprising two dinuclear units joined by two μ2-chlorides and two μ3-chlorides. The crystal contains one lattice THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, follow the IIa procedure: react the ligand precursor with NaNH2 in THF at room temperature for 20 h, filter into a YCl3 suspension, and reflux overnight.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for the initial reaction; THF reflux after YCl3 addition
synthesis.time: 20 h initial reaction; reflux overnight; crystallization over days, following IIa procedure
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; reflux and n-hexane vapor diffusion following IIa procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Use 30 mL THF in total and follow the IIa filtration, concentration, and n-hexane vapor-diffusion procedure to obtain colorless crystals.

material_class.structural_family: Type III trinuclear mixed indenyl–amido cluster

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A trinuclear cluster containing both μ2-amido indenyl and bis(indenyl)amido ligands, a bridging Me2Si(NH)2 unit, and two μ2-chlorides. The three metal centers and two nitrogen atoms are nearly coplanar; the other bridging atoms lie above and below that plane.

synthesis.procedure: Under dry dinitrogen, add a THF solution of the ligand precursor to NaNH2 suspended in THF and stir at room temperature for 20 h. Filter the purple solution into a stirred GdCl3 suspension in THF at room temperature and stir overnight.
synthesis.time: 20 h before GdCl3 addition; overnight afterward; crystallization over days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/cannula techniques or glovebox under dry dinitrogen; n-hexane vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, concentrate the clear purple solution to approximately 8 mL, then diffuse n-hexane vapor to obtain colorless crystals.
